lines: Signing in is now guarded: against guessing, for suspended accounts, and on the way back to where you were going.
Five wrong passwords for one email in fifteen minutes, and sign-in pauses. The next try is refused, even with the right password.
The pause lifts as the oldest failure leaves the fifteen minutes. An unknown email pauses too, so it never tells who has an account.
A suspended member who gives the right password is told so, and to contact the team.
Open a member page while signed out, sign in, and you are taken straight back to it.
A link that tries to send you to another site after sign-in opens Home instead.
And one network can create five profiles an hour. The sixth is refused, and everything typed stays.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, slice nine point one: staff sign-in.
That's slice three point two. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
